capabilities_done: (1) composite src/particles.rs (AE-21; STU-CMP-075 particle world, STU-CMP-075a, STU-FX-011): ParticleWorld with explicit seed and deterministic start tick; emitters point / box / layer (births distributed by layer alpha CDF); birth rate as a piecewise-linear Track integrated EXACTLY (births per grid step = floor(I(g_s+1)) - floor(I(g_s)), global birth index); life / direction+spread / speed / size randomness from a per-particle splitmix64 stream keyed by (seed, index); gravity, air resistance (v *= exp(-k h)), turbulence = curl of a seeded quintic value-noise potential (divergence-free); size and opacity over life (LifeCurve), birth->death colour; dot (antialiased disc) and sprite (bilinear, transparent border, tinted) particle types; semi-implicit Euler on a shared grid (substeps 1..=16)

(1) random access: particles never interact, so frame T simulates ONLY particles alive at T from their own birth on the shared grid (partial step, whole grid steps, partial step to T); grid states never depend on the frame requested, so forward play, a jump and a backwards scrub are bit-identical with no simulate-from-0 and no checkpoint cache needed (cost bounded by alive x longest-life steps, checked first)

(1) motion blur through the composition shutter: ParticleShutter::from_settings(Folio StudioCompositionMotionSettings, layer_id) uses the composition adapter's sample-tick rule t + round(tpf (phase + angle (k + 0.5) / n) / 360) and averages premultiplied sample frames

(1) output: ParticleFrame (premultiplied f32 RGBA, digest) -> ParticleFrame::content = StaticContent (one owned straight tile under a coverage mask via text::painted), drawn by a composition scene layer through the existing pigment routes (render-cpu test; same routes as render-gpu, GPU run not performed by this lane)

(1) hostile bounds (V4-01/02): every parameter finite and in range (typed ParticleError::Parameter(field)), alive-count estimate (particle_count, hard ceiling 2^20), birth-window steps (particle_window), integration work (particle_work), raster work and raster size (particle_raster), sprite / layer-emitter shape, non-finite state (particle_non_finite, never dropped silently), cancellation; all before allocation

(2) pulse src/comp_audio.rs (AE-24; STU-MOT-016): CompAudioLayer (planar 1-2 ch source, signed start tick on the sample grid, in/out span, audio switch, solo, audio_levels LevelKey stereo dB pairs, linear in dB or held); each audible layer = two hard-panned mono score tracks (equal-power law exact (1,0)/(0,1) at the ends) whose volume_db lanes ARE the left/right level streams; CompAudioStream renders blocks, seeks by one session rebuild at the new origin (sources cut, lanes re-anchored), is a pulse AudioClock; composition_scheduler gives a PlaybackScheduler over the composition frame grid clocked by it; audio_amplitude = per-frame RMS x 100 of left/right and their mean (Convert Audio to Keyframes series)

(2) motion src/audio_amplitude.rs: insert_audio_amplitude writes <layer>/effects/{left_channel,right_channel,both_channels}/slider with one LINEAR key per frame, all-or-nothing; an expression reads the slider through the store HostRead (test provider)

(3) folio src/motion_preset.rs (AE-23; STU-MOT-110, STU-FX-142/143): StudioMotionPresetSet (style registry schema) of presets with category path, effect instances (instance_id, effect_kind) and properties (relative path, insert flag, StudioKeyedValue with composition keyframe rules, expression); validate_motion_presets + parse_motion_presets (shared Folio preflight, duplicate keys, unknown fields, budget); is_ffx + refusal of After Effects .ffx (RIFX/FaFX magic) with Code::UnsupportedSchema at MOTION_PRESET_FFX before any parsing

(3) motion src/preset.rs: capture_preset (origin = earliest key or explicit), validate_preset, apply_preset(store, root, preset, offset): Write entries need an existing path with the same component count, else PRESET_TARGET_INCOMPATIBLE naming every unmatched path (STU-MOT-111), Insert entries create effect-instance parameter groups (STU-MOT-017) with _2/_3 renames when the instance exists, keys shifted by the application time; every property built and checked before the first mutation (store and revision unchanged on refusal)

(3) composite src/temporal/motion_preset.rs (feature motion): preset_from_record / record_from_preset (lossless, composition keyframe interpolation and tangent mapping), apply_preset_record, import_preset_bytes with typed PresetImportError::ProprietaryFfx / Record

spec_basis: STU-CMP-075 (14.27.6 Simulation): 'Particle world | A full particle system with birth rate, longevity, producer position and radius, velocity, gravity, resistance, per-particle type, and size, opacity and colour over life, under a physics model.'

STU-CMP-075a: 'it MUST declare a deterministic start frame; it MUST produce identical output for identical parameters and seed ([STU-FX-011]); scrubbing backwards MUST either re-simulate from the start frame or serve a cached state, and MUST NOT show a different result than playing forwards; and the render scheduler MUST NOT parallelise across frames for a stateful simulation.'
STU-FX-011: 'Filters with a random component ... carry an explicit integer seed parameter so their output is reproducible.'

STU-MOT-016: 'The audio group carries audio_levels, a keyframable stereo-pair level stream. Audio level is animated on the same keyframe model as every other property; there is no separate audio automation format ([STU-FX-135]).'
STU-MOT-017: 'An effect instance is a property GROUP in the layer's tree, and its parameters are that group's children.'

STU-MOT-110: 'A motion preset is a StudioStyleRegistry entry ... A property preset writes values, keyframes and expressions into named property paths on the target ... A preset format that carries only static values cannot represent this material.'

STU-MOT-111: 'Preset application is path-based and MUST fail loudly on a mismatch. Applying a preset that targets a text animator to a solid layer produces a determinate PRESET_TARGET_INCOMPATIBLE result naming the unmatched paths, and applies nothing, rather than partially applying and leaving a half-rigged layer.'
notes.unverified_d5: After Effects parity is UNVERIFIED (D5): CC Particle World / Particular behaviour (direction convention 0 = up clockwise, birth jitter, draw order oldest-first, dot falloff, sprite tint), Convert Audio to Keyframes scale (Studio: RMS x 100 per frame) and layer/effect naming, audio-levels interpolation in dB and mono-layer feed to both sides at unity, .ffx semantics (never read).
notes.stateful_scheduling: STU-CMP-075a's 'MUST NOT parallelise across frames' targets state carried frame to frame; this model carries none (each frame is a pure function of parameters, seed and tick), so frames are independent by construction; stated, not hidden.
